subject: Rehoming of Friendly, Socialized, Fixed Stray Cats✌️
content:
Hello my name is Joyce. I rent a room in a house 10 minutes south of UTA.
I've been tending to several strays in the neighborhood with capturing,
rehoming, TCAP fixes, shots etc. Two of the adults are the friendly kind. A
black male who's used to shelter and lots of petting and then there's an
adult female tabby, who's regular feeder moved from the area a while ago,
who's warmed up a lot to human attention while healing indoors after
getting her spay from TCAP. They both received their three year rabies
shots for ferals and ear tipped.

May I offer these two to your rehoming program? I could join them with the
colony at UTA but they may instinctually try to journey south again. Any
suggestions would be appreciated. Thank you for your time and consideration.

subject: Website and Mobile Application Accessibility Project - Site Ownership Follow-up
content:
Hi Campus Cats of UTA,

As part of the website and mobile application accessibility project we told you about last week, OIT Web Publishing Services is working to confirm site and application owners are listed correctly.

You have been identified as the owner of the website(s) and/or application(s) listed below. If you believe there are any errors with this list, let us know as soon as possible.

After reviewing the list, please respond by May 16, 2025, letting us know if you have a plan to remediate accessibility issues or if you would like our assistance in remediation.

Sites requiring OIT assistance will be placed in a work queue and remediated over the course of the project. OIT will work to minimize any changes that may impact the current structure/layout of sites. However, in some cases, it may be necessary to restructure, redesign or completely rebuild sites using approved themes and architecture to meet accessibility requirements. 

In cases involving websites or applications developed or hosted by external vendors, OIT will work to provide information about identified issues. Owners are responsible for facilitating communication on accessibility issues and requesting remediation on behalf of the university. 

OIT will provide reporting to keep the university audience informed on progress as the project proceeds.

If we do not hear back from you, we will contact your department’s leadership to escalate the request and expedite the remediation process. All websites and mobile applications must be accessible by April 2026.

Thank you for your continued partnership in this important effort.

Websites/applications you are designated as owner for:


  1.  https://www.catsofuta.org




Thank you,
OIT Web Publishing Services

Good morning Celeste!

I don’t have a preference at all! Both Eevee and Pescado seem really sweet.
I’m free Monday 5/12 at any time, Tuesday 5/13 after 1:00pm, and Wednesday
5/14 at any time.

been around other cats.

Thank you so much!

Jacquelyn

subject: Seeking Temporary Foster for Sweet 8-Year-Old Cat
content:
Hi there,
I’m reaching out to ask if you or anyone you know might be able to foster an eight-year-old indoor cat. She’s very sweet, affectionate, and has been a beloved companion. Unfortunately, due to a recent issue with her urinating outside the litter box,likely triggered by the upstairs AC breaking and her seeking a more comfortable spot; my father has insisted I rehome her.
I’ve worked hard on training and caring for her, and this has been incredibly difficult. I’m hoping to find a temporary foster situation, ideally for about a year, until I’m able to move out and take her back. I’ve been reaching out all week, but many leads have fallen through, and I’m honestly running out of options.
I understand this might be a lot to ask, I just really want to do right by her and make sure she’s safe and cared for.
Thank you so much for your time and any help you can offer.
Best,Jorge Luis Covarrubias
Ps. She is all healthy and shots are up to date.

subject: Baby Gray Tabby
content:
We found a baby Gray Tabby approximately 4 weeks old abandoned and crying
loudly at the park next to College Park. We didn't know whether to just
ignore but when we saw she was too young to be alone we took her to get
some food but we have 4 senior cats in our apartment and we cannot keep
her. We need to know if there is a mother cat on campus missing her baby or
was she dumped there. She was found on campus so is there someone who can
take care of her. She is eating hard food, her eyes are still blue and she
should still be with her mother. Thank you.

Nancy Anderson

subject: Sweet Young Cat Mom & 5 kittens
content:
Hi!

I am a cat lover from North Richland Hills,TX  and currently live in an
apartment with my 3 indoor cats. Last Tuesday the sweetest young mama known
to man came by and placed 6 of her kittens in my downstairs neighbor's
storage shed. They enter thru the gap in the bottom. 2 have outgrown the
gap. I have been feeding them as well as the apartment plex, but one of the
babies is missing and the babies aren't doing too good. We are taking them
inside and I will keep them in my bathroom. I am writing to see who I can
contact, or if you, can take the mama and kittens. I do not have space for
them all but I can't go all summer watching them get picked off one by one
by the coyotes. She has 5 now. They are QUIET kittens oh my gosh I never
hear them. They've been outside my door for 9 days now. Can you help me or
do you know of anyone who can take on beautiful sweet young mama and her 5
adorable babies? The humane society local is unfortunately no help.  Black
cats with white feet. 2 all black  Approx 2 months old possibly younger.
All hang close to mom. Sincerely a cat lover who's run out of space but I
can't sit back and do nothing, -Jessica

Please help!

Hi! My name is Lois Humphreys and I live in Arlington.  I'm looking for
someone to foster 4 kittens whose mama had to be euthanized on Memorial
day.  They will be 4 weeks old on Monday. They have been nursing until
yesterday and are being bottle fed now. Let me know if someone in your
group could help me please.
